# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c9 P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c3 P6](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is an elderly lady who sits by her kitchen window keeping a sharp eye on the main road. Her hands are work-hardened from years of diligent housewifery and nursing.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c9 P45](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0045), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001)_

## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is an outspoken, capable, and industrious woman who prides herself on always speaking her mind without fear or favor. Highly curious and attentive to her neighbors' affairs, she manages her own household efficiently while involving herself deeply in church, community, and political matters. Though frequently sharp-tongued, pessimistic, and prone to unsolicited advice, she possesses a kind heart and proves to be a dedicated, unwearied nurse and loyal neighbor.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c1 P30](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0030), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Living at Lynde's Hollow near Green Gables, Mrs. Rachel Lynde kept close watch over Avonlea affairs and actively led church organizations like the Sewing Circle and Church Aid Society. Upon learning that Marilla and Matthew Cuthbert intended to adopt an orphan boy, she visited Green Gables to investigate and was later shocked when Anne Shirley arrived instead. Her blunt comments on Anne's appearance caused Anne to fly into a fury at her, though Anne apologized the next day and won her back. Over the following years, Rachel monitored Anne's growth, eventually coming to admire her despite initially doubting the adoption. After her husband Thomas Lynde suffered a prolonged illness and passed away, she was forced to sell their mortgaged farm. Rather than moving away to live with her daughter Eliza, she accepted Marilla Cuthbert's invitation to move into Green Gables. She continued living there as a mainstay of the household, helping manage Davy and Dora Keith, helping prepare Anne's wedding, and spending her old age knitting quilts for Anne's daughters while offering advice on visits to Four Winds.
